notes.title: I Am Your President: Prologue is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36345844/33e601a6b4acdee1dec6b7944a548580b73adc1a.png[/img]

Our close friends from President Studio Games have shared some exciting news with us! They are publishing a free-to-play prologue to their first game: I Am Your President. 

Those that have political aspirations of the highest caliber can learn more and get the game here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1201330/

notes.title: We need your feedback!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36345844/671b798ecfde1a0bc1fd506caa4c1706257c2f69.png[/img]

Hello, Samurai!

As 'Samurai Simulator' is being intensively worked on, this step has come when we want your feedback. We have created an online questionnaire that we hope will help us create a better production and meet your expectations. We encourage you to share your ideas with us.

You can find the link to the questionnaire below:

[b][url=http://bit.ly/samurai_questionnaire]QUESTIONNAIRE HERE[/url][/b]

Thank you for your feedback!
